caption: The top of a touch-sensitive lamp is tapped, and it lights up.

sa.check: A lamp with a touch-sensitive body.
The top of the lamp is tapped.
The lamp is dark before the tap.
The order is dark, tap, lit.

pc.expect: The lamp lights at the moment the fingertip touches it, and only then.
pc.fail: The lamp is tapped and stays dark; or the lamp is lit before the touch; or the lamp comes on while the hand is still away from it; or the lamp lights when the table beside it is tapped.

pc.expect: Once lit the lamp stays lit steadily until it is touched again.
pc.fail: The lamp goes dark again with nothing touching it; or flickers on and off; or changes brightness repeatedly with the hand withdrawn; or lights and fades out at once.

pc.expect: The lamp's light reaches its surroundings: the shade glows and nearby surfaces brighten, with shadows pointing away from the lamp.
pc.fail: The bulb glows while the shade and table stay as dark as before; or the surroundings brighten while the lamp stays dark; or the light comes from a place other than the lamp.

pc.expect: The lamp stays put as it is tapped; nothing else on the table moves.
pc.fail: The lamp slides, tips or lifts at the tap; or items on the table jump; or the shade turns by itself.

pc.expect: One lamp; it keeps its shape; the finger touches its surface and passes through nothing.
pc.fail: A second lamp appears; or the lamp vanishes; or the finger passes into the lamp; or the lamp changes shape.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The lamp's colour and shade, the table and the wall stay the same apart from the light.
pc.fail: The shade changes colour rather than brightness; or the base changes; or the table's contents rearrange.
